maria: Draft RN posted for Wed 09:00 UTC. Highlights: throughput uplift, canary routing tweaks, Dedicated autoscale stabilization. Need pin matrix + short staff microcopy.

aj: Trimming TL;DR now, aiming for <80 chars.

sasha: Please include customer-impact line. Legal prefers "no API changes" phrasing.

ops-oncall: Ops asks: canary % + rollback criteria? Also quiet window.

maria: Proposal: canary 4% for 15m -> 25% on green. Rollback if errors >2% or p50 latency +25%. Quiet window 08:45-10:45 UTC. Maintainers: aj, rachel, ops-oncall.

aj: Deploybot command:
```
/deploy schedule --service=r-runtime --image=redwood/runtime:v2.3.3-canary --canary=4% --canary-duration=15m --expand=25% --rollback-on-error=2% --team=eng-runtime
```

ops-oncall: Team flag confirmed. I'll attach canary dashboard and set a 5m heartbeat.

sasha: Microcopy OK: "No API changes; performance and routing improvements." Legal cleared.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by aj for 2024-03-06T09:00:00Z. Canary/ramp/rollback configured as above.

maria: If RN is green by EOD I'll pin the internal announce and fire the deploybot. Thanks. :rocket:
